title: Hardcore x Create
description: A modern Minecraft modpack focused on Create automation, magic, farming, exploration, and immersive gameplay with optimized performance and countless creative possibilities.
body:
Step into a modern Minecraft experience that seamlessly combines technology, magic, automation, and atmosphere into one cohesive gameplay journey. This modpack is designed to give you maximum creative freedom — from building complex factories to conducting magical experiments and enjoying relaxed farming.

## ⚙️ Technology & Automation at the Core

At the heart of the modpack lies the renowned Create ecosystem. With numerous addons such as Create: Encased, Create Crafts & Additions, Create Slice & Dice, Create Enchantment Industry, Create Aeronautics, Create Hypertubes, and many more, you can build vast, living machine networks.

Whether you're creating automated farms, conveyor systems, aircraft, or intricate production chains, your engineering possibilities are virtually limitless.

## 🌾 Farming & Survival Enhancements

With Farmer's Delight, RightClickHarvest, and 3D Crops Revamped, farming becomes more immersive and rewarding. Cooking, harvesting, and processing resources play a meaningful role in your progression.

## 🔮 Magic & Mysticism

Ars Nouveau and Ars Creo introduce a powerful magical dimension to complement your technological world. Harness spells, glyphs, and magical automation to unlock entirely new possibilities.

## 🏗️ Storage & Convenience

Keep your world organized with Sophisticated Backpacks, Storage Drawers, and a wide range of quality-of-life mods. JEI, Jade, AppleSkin, Mouse Tweaks, and Controlling ensure that information is always at your fingertips.

## 🌍 Exploration & Atmosphere

Never lose your way thanks to Xaero's Minimap and World Map. AmbientSounds, Fresh Animations, and Entity Texture/Model Features bring the world to life with a rich and immersive atmosphere.

## ⚡ Performance & Optimization

The modpack is highly optimized with Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, and ImmediatelyFast. Even large-scale machine setups and complex worlds run smoothly and efficiently.

## 🧱 Building & Decoration

Create Deco, Create Design n’ Decor, Create Interiors, and Copycats+ provide countless options for detailed, stylish, and creative builds.

## 🐉 Extras & Adventure

Discover additional content through Create: Dragons Plus, explore richer ocean environments with Create Deep Seas, manage villagers more efficiently using Easy Villagers, and take advantage of modern transportation solutions.

## 📦 Included mods


<details>
<summary>Modlist</summary>

This modpack includes, among others, the following mods: GraveStone Mod, Hardcore Revive+, Just Enough Items (JEI), Create, Create: Design n’ Decor, Create: Encased, Create Crafts & Additions, Create Slice & Dice, Create Enchantment Industry, Create Aeronautics, Create Hypertubes, Create Deco, Create Connected, Create Stuff ’N Additions, Create Copycats+, Create Deep Seas, Create: Copper & Zinc, Create: Power Loader, Create: Dragons Plus, Farmer’s Delight, Ars Nouveau, Ars Creo, Sophisticated Backpacks, Sophisticated Core, Storage Drawers, Jade, AppleSkin, Xaero’s Minimap, Xaero’s World Map, Dynamic FPS, Sodium, Lithium, FerriteCore, ImmediatelyFast, Entity Culling, Iris Shaders, Continuity, AmbientSounds, LambDynamicLights, Entity Model Features, Entity Texture Features, Fresh Animations, Fresh Moves, 3D Skin Layers, Mouse Tweaks, Controlling, Searchables, Mandala’s GUI (Dark Mode), Easy Villagers, RightClickHarvest, 3D Crops Revamped, CreativeCore, Architectury API, Forgified Fabric API, Sinytra Connector, Curios API, JamLib, and many additional performance, quality-of-life, and visual enhancement mods.

</details>
